There hasn't been what I would call a hard bounce off of that level, but instead riding the coat-tails of the trend-line higher. Enveloping that rising trend-line is a rising channel as well. Any strong bounce off the rising trend-line would likely see AAPL retest its upper channel band and form new all-time highs in the process. And that is an area that has acted as heavy resistance in the past. I think even more so, what wouldn't surprise me is with the lack of bounce off of the rising trend-line, if it broke that support, and pulled back to the lower channel band for a potential bounce play.

items.content_excerpt: Qualcomm and Arm Holdings began a new five-day jury trial on Monday, with Qualcomm accusing Arm of withholding chip-testing tools required under their licensing agreement and leaking information to the media about its 2024 threat to terminate a key license. Qualcomm claims the alleged leak damaged negotiations for a chip agreement with Meta Platforms and is seeking to suspend royalty payments to Arm for up to five years, potentially involving billions of dollars. Judge Maryellen Noreika is considering whether to enforce or remove the five-year royalty-suspension provision from the contract; if removed, Qualcomm could face a substantially smaller damages claim. Arm, owned by Japan’s SoftBank, denies breaching the agreement or harming Qualcomm’s chip negotiations, calling the claims speculative. Arm also argues Qualcomm cannot seek damages over the leaked termination letter because Qualcomm itself disclosed confidential details of antitrust investigations involving Arm. $QCOM $ARM $META

items.content_excerpt: $NVAX Two good questions. On the MMs: they don't push, they hedge. Dealers who sold the Oct 11/12/12.50 calls were barely hedged at $10.50 and had to buy stock all the way up – that amplifies a move, it doesn't start one. On the converts: the 2031 notes convert at $11.14, so at $12.56 each $1,000 note is worth ~$1,127 – 13% in the money. Effects: (1) the arb funds holding them short MORE stock as delta rises, which is why borrow went to zero yesterday – they're not covering. (2) Novavax can only redeem early from September 5, 2028, and only if the stock holds above 130% of the conversion price (~$14.48). Holders can't freely convert before June 2031. So the notes – and their hedges – stay in place for at least two more years regardless of price. (3) The ~12% dilution is already in the diluted share count. Higher price makes the notes equity-like and refinancing easy; it doesn't retire them yet. NFA.
